address: 245 Yucheng Road, Zuoying District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan
bio: This simple shop with wooden tables covered in childlike doodles is always jam-packed with customers in search of classic comfort food. Its signature is undoubtedly the eponymous duck rice – smoked duck pieces on steamed rice drizzled with a secret sauce. Another speciality, hand-sliced duck leg rice, is available in limited quantity and boasts smoky, juicy flesh. And of course, the duck goes down a treat with the wide range of noodles. Try assorted duck offal soup and side dishes made with bean sprouts.
